relevant_scoring_play: Foul called on Udonis Haslem at Q4 3:24 incorrectly attributed to Shaquille O'Neal, causing O'Neal to foul out at OT 0:51.9 with only 5 fouls
score_after_original: Game ended ATL 117 - MIA 111 OT (with Shaq disqualified)
score_after_corrected: Game replayed from 0:51.9, final ATL 114 - MIA 111 (after replay March 8 2008)

corrected_value.player_stat: Shaquille O'Neal: 5 fouls (should not have been disqualified)

sources_that_disagreed: Official scorer book vs referee crew vs stat crew
what_changed: Foul attribution from O'Neal to Haslem. O'Neal should not have fouled out. Game protested and final 51.9 seconds replayed months later.
when_changed: Protest filed Dec 2007, upheld Jan 11 2008, replay March 8 2008
cause: Hawks Official Scorer mistakenly attributed Haslem foul to O'Neal at Q4 3:24. NBA Commissioner David Stern found Hawks grossly negligent for failing to follow league-mandated scoring procedures and failing to respond when stat crew noticed mistake.
resolution: NBA upheld protest, fined Hawks $50,000. Game resumed March 8 2008 at 0:51.9 OT with score 114-111 (Horford FTs counted). No further scoring in replay, final 114-111. Only successful protest in last 41 years at that time.
